dataset.role: the prospectively locked D5 normal-brain confirmation sample

event.role: fixed before D5 was opened in the preceding confirmation gate

label_rule.ambiguous_or_doublet: the two best eligible lineages both score at least 0.50 and their score margin is below 0.35, or the nucleus is above the 99.5th GEX-UMI percentile and the runner-up is eligible with score at least 0
label_rule.assignment: select the highest lineage score when its selected submodule detects at least two markers, its score is at least 0.50, and its margin over the runner-up is at least 0.35
label_rule.fnbp1_exclusion: FNBP1 is excluded from the library-size denominator and is absent from all marker modules
label_rule.lineage_score: maximum of the lineage's two submodule scores
label_rule.marker_standardization: z-score each transformed marker over all 10,261 nuclei and clip to [-3,3]
label_rule.missing_or_unresolved: unresolved when the best lineage fails the marker-detection, score, or margin rule and does not meet the ambiguous/doublet rule
label_rule.submodule_score: mean marker z-score, then z-score that mean over all nuclei

reporting.denominator: all H5-labelled nuclei in each group, including nuclei absent from the targeted archive dictionary
outputs: include_only, exclude_only, and both informative molecules
event-bearing cells and rate per 1,000 group nuclei

timing.prior_information_allowed: the already reported D5 bulk total of 72 include-only, 2 exclude-only, and 0 both
timing.prohibited_before_lock: inspection of FNBP1 event evidence stratified by these labels
